scope: Six newly installed stores, native noon stills and original accepted courtyard visual target. Installation and geometry checks do not establish visual acceptance.
overallFindings: All six replacements have distinct entrance/roof geometry and human-scale closed entrances; original porch height and routes retained.
Front/rear/side/roof/door images were inspected for every store. No gross opening, floating wall or detached roof was visible in these views.
Material response and activity remain far below the accepted courtyard target: blank side/rear fields, dark recesses, and sparse service/stock detail.

Separate store lettering is readable and not mirrored. Diagnostic views retain the unchanged player and interaction overlay at Vex; these are fixed-camera views, not claims that Vex is at every store.
scoreNotes: 0–5 reviewer estimates. Null categories require motion/actor review; no category average is an acceptance decision.

buildings.improvement: Offset entry, broad upper window, tanks and visible connecting roof pipes; filter manifold connected at the facade.
buildings.remainingDefects: Blank side and rear walls; filters need convincing mounts, valves and service labels. Dark tank/filter finish loses form in shade.

buildings.improvement: Lower pitched roof, loading shutter, separate staff door and two grounded canopy posts.
buildings.remainingDefects: Storage/loading props remain sparse. The shaded shutter, sign and staff entrance need material/light separation; rear wall remains plain.

buildings.improvement: Workshop shutter and separate door, raised roof ventilation, supported exhaust and rear louvre.
buildings.remainingDefects: Workshop props and access/service details remain sparse; shutter and ventilation read as uniform dark metal. Side walls remain blank.

buildings.improvement: Pitched loft, unequal windows, wall-mounted hoist and separate reclaimed facade panels.
buildings.remainingDefects: Hoist and reclaimed panels need more working context; panel ageing is broad, rear wall plain, dark windows lack depth.

buildings.improvement: Three narrow upper windows, plum supported shade and roof drying-frame cloth.
buildings.remainingDefects: Folded rooftop cloth is sparse and stiff; no rich textile-work display. Plain rear/side walls and dark entrance remain.

buildings.improvement: Broad shutter, recessed display, clerestory and offset roof monitor.
buildings.remainingDefects: Display is empty/dark; tools and active working props remain missing, with plain rear/side wall fields.
